credit: Hans Kuepper, PromptQuorum, The State of Local AI, Report 01

symbols.name: chicken
symbols.title: Chicken: capable hardware
symbols.description: A violet chicken. In the State of Local AI report, a chicken stands for a computer that can run a good local AI model.

symbols.name: egg
symbols.title: Egg: an app worth using
symbols.description: A cream egg with a violet outline. In the State of Local AI report, an egg stands for a local AI app that is worth using.

symbols.name: chicken-egg-pair
symbols.title: Chicken and egg
symbols.description: A chicken and an egg side by side: hardware and apps.

symbols.name: few-chickens
symbols.title: Few chickens
symbols.description: Three small chickens in a row. Illustrative, not to scale: few computers can run a good local AI model.

symbols.name: even-fewer-eggs
symbols.title: Even fewer eggs
symbols.description: One egg and two empty dashed nests. Illustrative, not to scale: even fewer local AI apps are worth using.

symbols.name: persona-home-user
symbols.title: Egg-seeker: home user
symbols.description: A green egg with a house. The reader who wants to download an app and use it without a terminal.

symbols.name: persona-developer
symbols.title: Chicken-keeper: developer
symbols.description: A violet chicken with code brackets on its body. The developer and early adopter who runs models today.

symbols.name: persona-enterprise-it
symbols.title: Flock manager: enterprise IT
symbols.description: An amber chicken with a shield on its body. The buyer who cares about fleets, budgets and supply.

symbols.name: persona-journalist
symbols.title: Egg-checker: journalist and analyst
symbols.description: A red egg with quotation marks. The reader who quotes figures and checks sources.
